description: This file contains unit tests for various utility functions and components within the OpenClaw project. It includes test methods for age formatting, SSH target parsing, connection settings, gateway entry point resolution, log file selection, and gateway entrypoint handling when files are missing.

classes.name: UtilitiesTests
classes.description: Test suite for utility functions in the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: `age strings cover common windows`
methods.description: Tests age formatting for various time intervals to ensure correct human-readable strings.

methods.name: `parse SSH target supports user port and defaults`
methods.description: Verifies that SSH target parsing correctly extracts user, host, and port, including default port assignment.

methods.name: `sanitized target strips leading SSH prefix`
methods.description: Checks that connection settings correctly handle SSH prefixes and default settings.

methods.name: `gateway entrypoint prefers dist over bin`
methods.description: Ensures the gateway entry point selects the 'dist/index.js' file over the 'bin/openclaw.js'.

methods.name: `log locator picks newest log file`
methods.description: Validates that the LogLocator picks the most recently modified log file from a directory.

methods.name: `gateway entrypoint nil when missing`
methods.description: Confirms that the gateway entry point returns nil if no appropriate files are present.
